# animspec

> Deterministic, declarative animation. The same spec, signal and seed always produce the
> same frame — byte-identical on arm64 and x64, within a small tolerance across them.

animspec is a Node.js library (ESM, Node 22+, the `@napi-rs/canvas` software rasteriser)
that draws a single frame of an `AnimSpec` onto a canvas the caller provides. Models
author **specs**, never code.

## The model contract

- A spec is JSON: `{ background?, accent?, font?, layers: [...] }`. Always run it through
  `validateAnimSpec` before drawing and surface `result.dropped` — the validator drops
  unknown layer types, clamps params to their registry bounds, and reports both.
  [User guide](./user-guide)
- The vocabulary is generated from the registry. Show a model a bounded, deterministic
  subset: `select(PRIMITIVES, { kit, breadth, seed })`, then `buildVocabPrompt(subset)` and
  `buildJsonSchema(subset)` for the text and the schema. [Vocabulary](./vocabulary),
  [Gallery](./gallery)
- A layer may carry a `bind` map to drive any numeric param from a SignalFrame feature
  (`amplitude`, `energy`, `band:<n>`, or a seeded `osc` oscillator).
  [User guide — signal bindings](./user-guide)

## Public API

- `drawSpec(ctx, dims, frame, spec, opts)` — draw one frame.
- `validateAnimSpec(input)` — validate an untrusted spec and report what was dropped.
- `select(PRIMITIVES, …)` / `buildVocabPrompt(subset)` / `buildJsonSchema(subset)` —
  the vocabulary surface shown to models.
- SignalFrame track format: `encodeSignalTrack`, `decodeSignalTrack`, and the per-frame
  reader `readSignalTrackHeader` / `readSignalFrame` / `indexSignalTrackSidecar`.
- CLI: `animspec render <spec.json> --signal <track.asft> [--seed n] [--start n] [--end n]
  (--raw | --png <dir>)` — raw RGBA on stdout or a PNG folder, JSON reports on stderr.

## Hard rules

- Deterministic: a frame is a pure function of `(spec, signal, seed)`. Never `Math.random`
  or `Date`; seeded randomness only.
- Palette only: `palette.bg`, `palette.fg`, `palette.accent`. Monochrome by default.
- Text uses the shipped fonts only. No network or file access in `src/`.
- The host owns: canvas creation, audio → `SignalFrame`, file writing, and playback.
